title: Advanced Participle Clauses
completion_message: ¡Magnífico! Las Participle Clauses avanzadas ('Having done...', 'Given that...') te permiten combinar ideas complejas con elegancia y economía de palabras. Son imprescindibles para redactar a nivel directivo.

parts.visual:
Las Participle Clauses combinan dos oraciones con el mismo sujeto para hacer el texto más fluido y formal. 
1. Present Participle (-ING) para acciones simultáneas o causas: 
Normal: Because they knew the risks, they rejected the deal. 
C1 Participle: KNOWING the risks, they rejected the deal. 

2. Perfect Participle (HAVING + Past Participle) para una acción completada ANTES que otra: 
Normal: After we had signed the contract, we celebrated. 
C1 Participle: HAVING SIGNED the contract, we celebrated.
parts.audio: Participle Clauses combine two sentences with the same subject to make the text more fluid and formal. Number 1: Present Participle, ending in -ING, is used for simultaneous actions or to show cause. Normal sentence: Because they knew the risks, they rejected the deal. C1 Participle version: KNOWING the risks, they rejected the deal. Number 2: Perfect Participle, formed by HAVING plus Past Participle, is used for an action completed BEFORE another action. Normal: After we had signed the contract, we celebrated. C1 Participle version: HAVING SIGNED the contract, we celebrated.

parts.visual:
3. Past Participle (-ED/irregular) con sentido pasivo: 
Normal: Because it was manufactured in China, the product is cheaper. 
C1 Participle: MANUFACTURED in China, the product is cheaper. 

4. Sujetos diferentes (Absolute Clauses) - Nivel muy avanzado: 
Si las dos partes tienen sujetos distintos, se mantiene el sujeto en la cláusula del participio. 
Normal: Because the project was delayed, we lost money. 
C1 Absolute: THE PROJECT BEING DELAYED, we lost money.
parts.audio: Number 3: Past Participle, ending in -ED or irregular, is used with a passive meaning. Normal: Because it was manufactured in China, the product is cheaper. C1 Participle version: MANUFACTURED in China, the product is cheaper. Number 4: Different subjects, also known as Absolute Clauses. This is very advanced. If the two parts have different subjects, you keep the subject in the participle clause. Normal: Because the project was delayed, we lost money. C1 Absolute version: THE PROJECT BEING DELAYED, we lost money.

questions.question: Normal: Because he wanted to impress the boss, he worked late. -> ____ to impress the boss, he worked late.
Normal: After she had finished the report, she left the office. -> ____ the report, she left the office.
questions.explanation: Perfect Participle (Having + participio) para acción previa completada.

questions.question: Normal: Because it was built in 1920, the factory needs renovation. -> ____ in 1920, the factory needs renovation.
Normal: Because the CEO resigned, the stock dropped. -> The CEO ____, the stock dropped. (Absolute clause - sujetos diferentes).
questions.explanation: Absolute clause: Sujeto 1 (CEO) + participio (having resigned), Sujeto 2 (the stock) + verbo.

questions.question: Normal: Since we understand your concerns, we will offer a discount. -> ____ your concerns, we will offer a discount.
Normal: After he was promoted to VP, he hired a new team. -> ____ to VP, he hired a new team. (Pasiva previa).
questions.explanation: Perfect Participle Pasivo: Having been + participio.

questions.question: Normal: Because the budget was approved, we can start. -> The budget ____ approved, we can start.
questions.explanation: Absolute clause pasiva: The budget BEING approved...

questions.question: Normal: After they analyzed the data, they found a trend. -> ____ the data, they found a trend.
questions.explanation: Perfect Participle para acción previa: Having analyzed.

questions.question: Normal: Because it is located in the city center, the office is expensive. -> ____ in the city center, the office is expensive.
Normal: Not wanting to offend the client, she stayed silent. -> ____ to offend the client, she stayed silent.
questions.explanation: Negación en participios: NOT va antes del participio (-ing).

questions.question: Normal: Because the market crashed, we lost our investment. -> The market ____, we lost our investment. (Absolute).
questions.explanation: Absolute clause: The market having crashed (acción previa terminada por otro sujeto).

questions.question: Normal: After we had not received a reply, we called them. -> ____ a reply, we called them.
Normal: Since it is driven by AI, the software is very fast. -> ____ by AI, the software is very fast.
Normal: While he was reading the contract, he found an error. -> ____ the contract, he found an error.
Normal: Because all things are considered, it's a good deal. -> All things ____, it's a good deal. (Frase hecha / Absolute).
questions.explanation: Absolute clause pasiva muy común: All things considered.

questions.question: Normal: After she was told the news, she resigned. -> ____ the news, she resigned.
questions.explanation: Perfect Participle pasivo: Having been told (después de que se le dijo).

questions.question: Normal: Because time is running out, we must decide now. -> Time ____ out, we must decide now. (Absolute).
questions.explanation: Absolute clause con acción continua: Time running out...

questions.question: Normal: Since we realized the mistake, we apologized. -> ____ the mistake, we apologized.
questions.explanation: Present Participle para causa: Realizing (o Having realized también sería correcto, pero Realizing es más común para procesos mentales).

questions.question: Normal: Because it was written in haste, the email contained typos. -> ____ in haste, the email contained typos.
Normal: Because the weather was bad, the flight was cancelled. -> The weather ____ bad, the flight was cancelled. (Absolute).
questions.explanation: Absolute clause con verbo ser: The weather being bad...

questions.question: ____ the risks, we declined. (Sabiendo - know)
____ finished the report, she left. (Habiendo terminado)
____ in China, it's cheap. (Fabricado - manufacture)
The CEO ____ resigned, the stock fell. (Habiendo renunciado)
____ wanting to offend, I stayed quiet. (Negación)
____ been promoted, he was happy. (Habiendo sido promovido)
All things ____, it's good. (Consideradas - consider)
The budget ____ approved, we started. (Siendo/estando - be)
____ realized the error, we called. (Dándonos cuenta - realize)
____ in the center, it is expensive. (Ubicado - locate)
